rules: Each named responsibility has exactly one canonical authority.
The Workflow Guard remains the sole transition authority.
The Enterprise Design Template remains the sole artifact-shape authority.
The Design Master Prompt remains the sole Design-generation authority.
The release manifest adds compatibility metadata and does not replace existing authorities.
Consumers read governance authorities; they do not publish competing status.

authorities.planned_action: metadata/reference-only; preserve transition semantics and Direct-mode section
authorities.rollback: restore the prior Guard document revision without changing unrelated Direct work

authorities.planned_action: metadata/reference-only; preserve all 18 sections and A-G preparation
authorities.rollback: restore the prior template revision without creating a second template

authorities.planned_action: metadata/reference-only; keep the Enterprise Design Standard as the output contract
append candidate v3.0 identity only after the release evidence is complete
authorities.rollback: restore the prior baseline metadata and retain the audit record

authorities.planned_action: reference the candidate release without adding phases, checks, agents, or commands
create the single candidate manifest in a later Apply phase
authorities.rollback: remove only the unapproved manifest artifact before Repository Ready

authorities.planned_action: create the candidate policy record; final freeze restoration remains manual
authorities.rollback: remove only the unapproved ADR before Repository Ready

authorities.planned_action: append a candidate record only after cross-document validation
authorities.rollback: restore the prior changelog revision; do not rewrite historical entries
